response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders AS o JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE CAST(o.date_order_placed AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), gender_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT gc.gender, gc.order_count, gc.order_count - ga.average_count AS above_average FROM gender_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN gender_average AS ga WHERE gc.order_count > ga.average_count
